Needs changes before merge.

The source change uses the existing per-call confirmation gate. The tests cover published delete tools, two denied calls, unchanged history, refusal messages, and approved deletes. I found no code blocker.

Results merged with main, locally:
- PR head: ee41f7eef7709d94a389e6d73df36782abb912d5.
- Main: f14097855b0e347a073f1e8cc74a889554e6dbbb.
- Trial merge: 5ed0d04d48a5bb1ddc8431348ab1a7c5ab8ab290. Its first parent is the PR head.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: all 10 steps passed, including the test build.
- UI lib: 1435 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored. Both new regression tests passed.
- boundary: 3 passed; boundary_picks: 7; contour_dxf_sketch: 2; sinker_setup: 2; tap_hand: 3; theme_example: 3; theme_files: 17; waterjet_tool: 1. No failures.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Heavy plan: no reached lanes. No heavy tests ran.

Extra suites run: none required. The diff changes no fixture directory, test data, or importer.

Safety and mutations: the diff changes the UI confirmation policy. It changes no posted G-code, geometry, collision checks, gouge checks, or stock simulation. No goldens moved. I did not rerun mutations; this review leaves the code unchanged.

Requested before merge:
1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/ai_chat/transport.rs:202` changes visible UI behavior, but the PR body has no before/after screenshots. Add both screenshots to the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch and link them in the PR body. Show the native delete result before the fix and the Allow/Deny confirmation after the fix. Do not add images to the PR branch.

Notes: live model endpoints and manual desktop interaction were not exercised. The review worktree and branch remain in place to keep the build warm.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: the missing before/after screenshots are now linked in the PR body.

- [Before](https://github.com/mkinney/Camcraft/blob/pr-screenshots/pr-3438/before.png?raw=true): the Native calls delete both operations and show successful results.
- [After](https://github.com/mkinney/Camcraft/blob/pr-screenshots/pr-3438/after.png?raw=true): both operations remain, and the panel shows Allow/Deny confirmation.

The captures use the actual panel and a scripted local Native transport.
Only the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch contains the images: commit `86f2cb9ae68aa0292d8417d44aff5013fbc317a8`.

The existing pins are `native_confirmation_covers_every_published_delete_tool` and `native_two_deletes_wait_for_confirmation_and_denial_preserves_job`.
Mutation check: both tests fail with the original guard. Both pass with the fixed guard restored.
All temporary capture changes are removed. The worktree is clean and remains in place.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 10 steps passed.
`cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

PR head remains `ee41f7eef7709d94a389e6d73df36782abb912d5`. This finding required no source change.
Please review this PR again.

Addressed: the latest review requests before/after screenshots. Both images are present on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch and linked in the PR body.

- [Before](https://github.com/mkinney/Camcraft/blob/pr-screenshots/pr-3438/before.png?raw=true) shows successful Native delete results.
- [After](https://github.com/mkinney/Camcraft/blob/pr-screenshots/pr-3438/after.png?raw=true) shows both operations and the Allow/Deny confirmation.

I verified both remote files and inspected both images. The images commit is `86f2cb9ae68aa0292d8417d44aff5013fbc317a8`.
No source change was required. The PR branch contains no screenshots or review evidence.

Current head: `ee41f7eef7709d94a389e6d73df36782abb912d5` (unchanged). The plain push reports everything up to date.

No new mutation check applies to this screenshot-only finding. The earlier comment records the source mutation checks.

Please review this PR again.

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The earlier screenshot finding is resolved. I opened both images linked in the PR body. The before image shows two successful deletes. The after image shows both operations and the Allow/Deny banner. The images are on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. The PR diff contains no images. I withdraw the earlier requested change.

The source change uses the existing confirmation gate for each native `delete_*` call. The tests cover published delete tools, two denied calls, unchanged document history, refusal messages, and deletes after approval. I found no blocker.

- boundary: 3 passed; boundary_picks: 7; contour_dxf_sketch: 2; sinker_setup: 2; tap_hand: 3; theme_example: 3; theme_files: 17; waterjet_tool: 1. No failures.

Goldens moved: none. The diff changes no recorded program.

Safety and mutations: this change controls UI confirmation. It changes no posted G-code, geometry, collision check, gouge check, or stock simulation. A safety-tier mutation rerun is not required. I did not rerun mutations. The author reports red tests with the original guard and green tests with the fix. Both tests passed in this review.

Requested before merge: none. Replace `needs-rework` with `merge-ready` because the screenshot finding is resolved and every check passed.

Notes: live model endpoints and manual desktop interaction were not exercised. The review worktree and branch remain in place to keep the build warm. No source changes were made.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
